title: Investigating chronic myeloid leukemia therapeutics: AI-optimized design and synthesis of 4-methylthiazole-2-amine derivatives with translocation control activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48261-48295

A series of 4-methylthiazole-2-amine derivatives (3a–f, 6g–j and 7) were prepared via a Hantzsch-type multicomponent reaction and characterized by FT-IR, 1H-NMR and 13C-NMR spectroscopy techniques.
